fixes.explanation: Yes, friend. They hold him "…until the will of the LORD should be made clear to them." (Leviticus 24:12) So they wait. I know that's hard, because waiting is a whole skill. Then the LORD speaks to Moses. (Leviticus 24:13)

problems.problem: “No guessing, no voting” states what the people did not do, but the passage does not say whether they guessed or voted.
